meta_description:
1,269 likes, 91 comments - themasoomminawalashow on October 8, 2026: "Comment “Link” to get the episode link straight into your DMs.

You’ve just had a baby. Everyone tells you this should be one of the happiest moments of your life. So what happens when you’re actually struggling to get through it?

On The Masoom Minawala Show, Neerja Birla, founder of The Aditya Birla Education Trust and Mpower, opened up about experiencing postpartum depression after the birth of her first daughter, Ananya — at a time when she didn’t even know postpartum depression existed.

The hardest part wasn’t only feeling low. It was the guilt of wondering why you weren’t feeling the happiness you were “supposed” to feel.

Sometimes, simply having a name for what you’re going through can change everything.

Also catch the full conversation on YouTube and Spotify.

Don’t carry the weight alone. Unpack The Baggage, call: 080 696 33333".
